scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a modest Casablanca living room with Moroccan sedari sofas. BRO1 and BRO2 stand close together, panicked and whispering, BRO1 grabbing his head with both hands, BRO2 looking toward a closed door with worried eyes. Head-to-waist framing, faces clearly visible, tense comic mood. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Casablanca living room at night. BRO1 and BRO2 sit on the sofa, leaning in, BRO2 counting ideas on his fingers, BRO1 biting his nails, both scared and unsure. Faces visible, central framing. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same living room. BRO1 holds a smartphone to his ear, calling, determined but nervous, while BRO2 leans close to listen with wide eyes. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A narrow Casablanca apartment staircase with tiled walls. BRO1 and BRO2 walk up the stairs side by side, serious faces, rehearsing what to say, BRO2 gesturing with one hand. Faces visible, subjects in the centre. 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A modern Moroccan apartment living room in daytime. SISTER stands in the foreground holding her phone, smiling a little too calmly and slightly suspicious, glancing sideways; behind her HUSBAND lounges lazily on the sofa in the middle of the day scrolling his phone. Head-to-waist framing for SISTER, faces visible. 2D animated illustration, no text.
